cases.description: Send a password-reset OTP to a registered email
cases.preCondition: A Customer account exists and is active
cases.procedure: Send POST /api/Auth/forgot-password/initiate with the email of the Customer account
cases.expectedResult: Returns 200 and an email containing the OTP is delivered to that mailbox

cases.description: Send a password-reset OTP to an unregistered email
cases.preCondition: The email does not exist in the system
cases.procedure: Send POST /api/Auth/forgot-password/initiate with an email that was never registered
cases.expectedResult: Returns 404 - a deliberate decision that favours a clear user experience over resisting email enumeration

cases.description: Request an OTP with a malformed email
cases.procedure: Send POST /api/Auth/forgot-password/initiate with a string that is not an email

cases.description: Request an OTP with an empty email
cases.procedure: Send POST /api/Auth/forgot-password/initiate with an empty email string
cases.expectedResult: Returns 400 without raising a server error

cases.procedure: Send POST /api/Auth/forgot-password/verify with an incorrect OTP

cases.description: Reset the password with an invalid token
cases.procedure: Send POST /api/Auth/forgot-password/reset with a made-up resetPasswordToken

cases.description: Reset the password with a 5-character password, one below the minimum of 6
cases.expectedResult: Returns 400 stating the 6-character minimum; the check runs BEFORE the token is consumed

cases.description: Reset the password with an empty password
cases.procedure: Send POST /api/Auth/forgot-password/reset with an empty newPassword
cases.expectedResult: Returns 400 stating the password must not be empty
